title: Make Thermite builds bit-reproducible with pinned seeds and per-item proof caching

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: OQ resolutions: cache at target/thermite-proof-cache/<sha256>.json (under gitignored target/); solver_time_ms reports stored value on a hit (oracle-excluded); content-address = lowered Verus source (what verus checks), not the AST. Key = sha256(lowered source + seed + verus version + thermite version) — soundness: captures everything affecting the verdict, hit==fresh-verify, any change=>miss. Additive cached:bool cert field. Decisive test: populate then run with verus off PATH -> cached L3. Next: builder (cache.rs + wire check.rs + sha2 dep + tests).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Implement forge per-item content-addressed proof cache (cache.rs): cache_key = sha256 over 4 domain-tagged length-prefixed inputs (lowered Verus source + seed + verus version + thermite version); load/store under target/thermite-proof-cache/<hex>.json with atomic temp+rename and corrupt-entry-degrades-to-MISS. Wire check.rs L3 path: resolve verus version once per run (VERUS_VERSION pin else verus --version; absent => VerusAbsent, never empty key), lookup BEFORE run_verus (HIT => with_cached(true), skip verus), store after MISS (with_cached(false)). Additive manifest::Certificate.cached (serde default, oracle-excluded so a hit is oracle-equal to a fresh verify). Soundness: a hit equals a fresh verify because the key captures every verdict-determining input. Tests: HIT, decisive verus-unavailable HIT, invalidation, locality (per-item key), determinism/purity, corpus-still-L3.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED — per-item content-addressed proof cache + bit-reproducible verification. cache_key = sha256(lowered Verus source + pinned seed + verus version + thermite version). forge check consults the cache per-item before run_verus (HIT -> cached cert + skip solver; MISS -> verify + store). Additive cached:bool cert field. Critic NO DIVERGENCE (soundness-critical): key completeness; the BODY-EDIT-NO-STALE-PASS test (changed body re-verifies L0, never stale L3); version-keying; determinism; the decisive solver-skip (cache serves L3 with verus off PATH).
